tools.name: loox_list_product_reviews
tools.description: List product reviews of the store, newest or best first, with rating, text, photos/videos, merchant reply, product, verified-purchase flag, AI highlights, country and moderation status. Merchant data: includes the reviewer's name, email, Shopify customer id and order id. Filter by product, star rati

tools.name: loox_get_product_review
tools.description: One product review by id, any moderation status (published, unpublished or pending), with full reviewer details. Merchant data: includes the reviewer's name, email, Shopify customer id and order id. GET /api/v1/store/{id}/product-reviews/{reviewId}.

tools.name: loox_list_store_reviews
tools.description: List store-level reviews (about the shop, not one product) with rating, text, merchant reply and moderation status. Merchant data: includes the reviewer's name, email, Shopify customer id and order id. Filter by star rating, status (default published) and date range (applied to createdAt). GET /api/

tools.name: loox_get_store_review
tools.description: One store-level review by id, any moderation status, with full reviewer details. Merchant data: includes the reviewer's name, email, Shopify customer id and order id. GET /api/v1/store/{id}/store-reviews/{reviewId}.

tools.name: loox_get_product_reviews_summary
tools.description: Overall rating of the store's published product reviews: total count, average stars and how many reviews per star (1-5). Public Storefront API, published reviews only. GET /storefront/v1/store/{id}/product-reviews/bottomline.

tools.name: loox_get_product_rating
tools.description: Review count and average star rating of ONE product (published reviews; 0 when it has none). Public Storefront API. GET /storefront/v1/store/{id}/product-reviews/bottomline/{productId}.

tools.name: loox_get_store_reviews_summary
tools.description: Overall rating of the store-level reviews: total count, average stars and how many reviews per star (1-5). Public Storefront API, published reviews only. GET /storefront/v1/store/{id}/store-reviews/bottomline.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: loox_list_product_reviews, loox_get_product_review, loox_list_store_reviews, loox_get_store_review, loox_get_product_reviews_summary, loox_get_product_rating, loox_get_store_reviews_summary · Public sink: loox_list_product_reviews, loox_get_product_review, loox_list_store_reviews, loox_get_store_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: loox_list_product_reviews, loox_get_product_review, loox_list_store_reviews, loox_get_store_review, loox_get_product_reviews_summary, loox_get_product_rating, loox_get_store_reviews_summary · Public sink: loox_list_product_reviews, loox_get_product_review, loox_list_store_reviews, loox_get_store_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
